description: This file defines the class 'updateDependencies' which manages task dependency updates within the SuiteCRM project, particularly updating project tasks based on changes to a given task's finish date and dependency relationships.

classes.name: updateDependencies
classes.description: A class responsible for updating task dependencies when task dates are modified, handling logic for different dependency types such as Finish-to-Start (FS) and Start-to-Start (SS).

methods.name: update_dependency
methods.description: Updates dependent project tasks' start and finish dates when the current task's finish date is changed, based on dependency type and date difference.

methods.name: count_days
methods.description: Calculates the difference in days between two dates, returning a string with a positive or negative day difference.
